status: UNRUN: source-authored acceptance plan, not execution evidence

cases.name: project_nested_history_bundle
cases.setup: Import one 9 MB RGB16 TIFF background with ICC; review source subject; apply; change shadow; undo; save project v22 and reopen
cases.expect: Original byte chunks and SHA, ICC SHA, decoded pixel SHA, source review recipe and both undo states survive. No source file writes.

cases.name: project_tampered_asset
cases.setup: Alter one bundled byte, hash reference, binding, or nested-history source identity independently
cases.expect: Entire malformed record fails; no missing-asset neutral fallback.

cases.name: project_missing_additive_key
cases.setup: Open existing v22 project without either ID-background key
cases.expect: Existing edits retained; ID background neutral only when absent.

cases.name: preset_target_review
cases.setup: Save enabled solid-background style; apply to target lacking independently reviewed selected scope

cases.name: batch_target_assets
cases.setup: Copy asset-mode style through frozen preflight to two reviewed targets with different immutable backgrounds
cases.expect: Target masks, source IDs and each target's own background bytes retained; layout/edge/shadow parameters copied.

cases.name: batch_conflict
cases.setup: After preflight alter target mask review or replace its background; attempt commit; after commit alter review then undo batch
cases.expect: Revision or target-recipe identity detects conflict; no overwrite of later work.

cases.name: full_source_tile_equivalence
cases.setup: Export reviewed source at multiple tile sizes including shadow beyond tile halo; compare full-source inspection to export
cases.expect: One full-domain shadow/edge preparation then exact cropped fields; no proxy alpha enlargement and no seams.

cases.name: original_source_change
cases.setup: Change source bytes before decode, during preparation, or during render
cases.expect: Fail source identity or stamp check; no export success.

cases.name: budget_and_cancel
cases.setup: Attempt >32MP and insufficient-memory full fields; cancel during support or native shadow preparation
cases.expect: Explicit budget rejection/cancellation with no lower-quality replacement.

cases.name: mutual_exclusion
cases.setup: Enable old replacement matte, studio background or sky, then enable ID background through preset/batch/export
cases.expect: Reject mutually exclusive combination in both edit and export routes.

cases.name: prior_pipeline_gates
cases.setup: Combine accepted ID background with color, people/body shaping, manual liquify, geometry and RGB16 output
cases.expect: Current pipeline RGB composited, not original photo pasted back; all prior source and preview identity gates preserved.
